anya (Product): BeaconCorp asked for a rapid pilot: private deploy, customer BYOK, per-tenant KV caching, and 100ms P95 for generation. They want a next-week window. Can we scope an MVP?

sam (Eng-Runtime): Feasible with constraints. BYOK avoids HSM latency but needs envelope encryption path. Per-tenant cache will increase RAM; we should pick a quantized model (eg opt-7b-quant) to hit 100ms.

mike (Infra): To reliably hit 100ms P95 we need reserved GPUs + prewarm nodes. Normal infra lead = 10bd; with exec sign-off we can do 3-5bd. Also need network egress to customer KMS endpoints.

lina (Security): Full HSM integration = ~3w (attestation + policy). BYOK pilot is allowed under temporary exception if we provide audit logs, key rotation policy, and limited traffic. I can draft the exception + checklist in 48h; legal must sign off.

carol (Eng-SRE): Observability checklist: per-tenant latency dashboard, token-level cost breakdown, alert at 120ms. Canary only for BeaconCorp traffic + synthetic spike tests. Add automated fallback to hosted model when latency breaches.

anya (Product): Proposal: run Option Fast (BYOK + per-tenant cache + target 100ms P95) as a scoped pilot. Owners: sam runtime, mike infra, lina security, carol SRE. Ack + ETA?

sam (Eng-Runtime): Ack. 72h for runtime flag, envelope flow, and basic tests.

mike (Infra): Ack. 5bd to provision reserved capacity; 3bd with exec sign-off.

lina (Security): Ack. Exception draft in 48h, then legal review.

carol (Eng-SRE): Ack. Canary runbook and dashboards by Thursday; will include rollback playbook.

ops-bot: Created ticket BEACON-PRIVATE-PILOT: https://tickets/BEACON-PRIVATE-PILOT — owners assigned, update timelines in ticket.

anya (Product): I'll confirm scope with BeaconCorp: "BYOK + per-tenant cache + 100ms P95 target; traffic scoped to pilot." Weekly check-ins M/W. Reopen thread for blockers.
